newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 12.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Priority for share listings is being given to major state-run companies in line with the nation's efforts to restructure the state sector.

- The standing of listed Shanghai household appliance makers has declined in the past few years due to outdated management being unable to cope with intensifying domestic and international competition.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China's industrial products are having a tough time competing with growing foreign imports with many domestic firms being burdened with heavy debt and declining reputations.
- China has produced too many motorcycles in the past few years with unsold warehouse stocks up 12.8 percent at end-1996 against end-1995.
